# Shaun Vincent

> UI/UX and visual designer based in Winnipeg, Canada. Personal portfolio site covering services, selected work, professional background, and contact.

Shaun Vincent is a UI/UX designer and marketing creative, currently Marketing Manager at Paragon Living, co-owner of Side Lane Studio, and founder, designer, and developer of Tucked (https://tucked.ca), a free, private budget app made in Canada. The Tucked web app is live; a native iPhone app is coming soon. Open to select freelance work in UI/UX design, branding, marketing creative, and web development/automation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://shaunvincent.net/): Overview, selected work (led by Tucked), experience, services, and a contact form.

- [Side Lane Studio](https://www.sidelanestudio.com/): Creative studio co-owned by Shaun.
